checks: Pixel access denied by default before Android picker opens
Fresh independent grants and native picker cancellation return to same module
Real system picker, private image resource and local detector feed module-owned 240 mm measurement offline
Module-owned unit selector converts centimetres to millimetres within displayed rounding
Real endpoint drag commits once; Undo and Android pointer cancellation restore the prior length
Accessible photo-pixel nudges are individually undoable
Real pinch and pan do not place endpoints; reset restores calibrated fit coordinates
Module-owned recalibration produces 228 mm from the same endpoints
Menu and rotation preserve the current module measurement
Two-times text remains operable in portrait and landscape with real picker and measurement
Perspective and EXIF-oriented photos recover the expected 240 mm length
Blank and duplicate reference cards reject calibration and clear earlier results
Out-of-range calibration is rejected before a length can be produced
Ordinary background discards selected image, calibration and endpoints
Process restart retains no selected photo or measurement
Marker detection has its own revocable grant even when image selection is still allowed
Revoking pixel access closes the old image session and denies a fresh picker request
Synthetic source bytes remain unchanged and diagnostics contain no photo URI or measurement data
In-place host upgrade preserves selected catalog, unrelated installed module and saved counter
Retired installed trial remains manageable with visible Find update and disabled old authority
Unconfirmed retired module updates to exact modern signed module without reusing legacy photo consent
Rollback to retired native code is blocked and current modern module stays runnable
Retired reinstallation rejected before consent; saved unrelated module data remains intact
Signed module update adds a working cm/mm conversion selector on identical installed APK bytes
Supported rollback removes update-only controls and original measurement behavior works on the same APK

notes: Retirement explanation and Find update action readable at normal and 2× font in portrait and landscape. Retired grant disabled; both new image grants visibly off in fresh consent.
Preview before and rollback show 24.0 cm with older controls; update shows 240.1 mm. Selector existence and operation also asserted on-device.
Secure module windows retain FLAG_SECURE; synthetic module display evidence comes from the emulator console, not weakened Android screenshot protection.
Final 0.2.2 flat, perspective and EXIF-oriented photos show 24.0 cm; normal landscape preserves the recalibrated 22.8 cm result. Photo and endpoint markers are visible.
At 2× font, result and Show controls remain readable/operable in both orientations; supporting instructions require scrolling within the bounded panel. No claim that all copy fits simultaneously.
Raw landscape emulator-console captures are rotated relative to the saved raster; they were reviewed as captured, without image alteration.

limits: Separate completed clean-snapshot Android 17 x86_64 scopes; not physical ARM64 execution or a continuous single run.
Synthetic planar images validate implementation and controls, not physical-camera accuracy.
Selected pixels reach module code under fresh explicit consent; revocation cannot erase copies already delivered.
Photos, calibration and measurements are intentionally transient and are not claimed to persist across update, rollback or background.
Camera native workflow remains migration debt; its full device suite was not rerun.
Only the marker JNI bridge native library changes; bundled models, other native libraries, signing identity and Android permissions match alpha28.
Debug prototype and failed/incomplete device runs are not acceptance of these optimized artifacts.
